Game Overview

At its heart, Fix your Spaceship is a casual game about stranded alien. Race against time, scavenge quirky parts, and use clever problem-solving to rebuild your spaceship. Navigate Earth's bizarre landscapes, improvise, and adapt to unexpected challenges. Can your ingenuity fuel the journey back home? Find out in this adventurous escapade!
